subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the predecessor lands and this head is refreshed if necessary, should the repository authorize removal of the temporary `qa-matrix` workspace package, lockfile importer, and private QA Lab facade?
rationale: The implementation and live proof support consolidation, but deleting a plugin/package and dependency-graph surface is an intentional compatibility decision reserved for an eligible human approver.

options.title: Land stack, then authorize removal
options.body: Merge the predecessor, refresh this PR against the resulting stack, revalidate the preserved CLI behavior, and approve the intentional dependency-graph deletion for that exact head.

options.title: Pause for compatibility consumers
options.body: Keep the temporary package until maintainers identify and migrate any remaining source-checkout consumers that still import its package or private facade.

options.title: Retain the compatibility package
options.body: Reject the cleanup and continue carrying parallel plugin and facade ownership despite QA Lab already owning the implementation.

recommendation.title: Land stack, then authorize removal
recommendation.body: Merge the predecessor, refresh this PR against the resulting stack, revalidate the preserved CLI behavior, and approve the intentional dependency-graph deletion for that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They are a recent adjacent QA Lab contributor following the stack and the best available candidate for the repository-level compatibility and dependency authorization decision.
